about: Board workloads for the remote CPU hunt (spec 2026-10-29-cpu-hunt-remote sections 5.1/5.2). GENERATED by tools/pick_workloads.py from the law-driven sweep (build/sweep.exe); hand entries are kind=hand and the gestures. rows_x1000: one value per kRevaTable row, x1000 of the normalised pot value. Gesture steps: at `block` (from the gesture's start) set `row` to `value_x1000` through the pot path; row -1 = a MOD key press, row -2 = SHIFT held + MOD press (clear_mod_layer). `bastian` is captured in Task 7. Per-workload material, as the sweep applied it at load: `excite` [deck A, deck B] = excite_other_deck set at load and held across the engine switch (apply_excite_hold; the BBD decks); `rec` [A, B] = REC latched from the load through the settle and released at its end (the SAMPLER decks); `settle_blocks` = untimed blocks after the load (2500 with a SAMPLER deck, else 500); `input` = what the sweep fed the audio input: `noise` = xorshift32 white noise through a one-pole low-pass (y += 0.2 (w - y)), times 0.6, the same on L and R, restarted at every load (about -12 dBFS peak); `silence` = zeros. Ranking: `rank` orders a pairing's tops by desk_ns.top8_mean (the mean of the 8 slowest blocks after the per-block minimum over reps).

sweep.note: SERIAL, one sweep.exe at a time on an otherwise idle desktop. Pass 1: --corners --random 200 --seed k (k = pairing index 1..16) --seconds 10 --reps 3 (rep-major); pass 2 (these CSVs): the top 20 of pass 1 by top8_mean_ns with silent_frac < 0.5 plus the 4 corners, --seconds 100 --reps 3; --input noise. Prefix consistency of pass 2 against pass 1 is 56-57 % (Task 4 report, fix round 1): the desktop ranking is a pre-filter, the board decides.
